description:
Cast the copy of Demonic Tutor from exile by paying {1}{B}, unpreparing Emeritus of Woe.
When you cast that spell, Spellweaver Helix's last ability triggers, allowing you to cast a copy of the Extra Turn Sorcery without paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the copy of Demonic Tutor, finding Siege-Gang Lieutenant and putting it into your hand.
Cast Siege-Gang Lieutenant by paying {3}{R}.
At the beginning of combat, Siege-Gang Lieutenant's first ability triggers, creating two 1/1/ red Goblin creature tokens with haste.
Activate Siege-Gang Lieutenant's last ability twice by paying {4} and sacrificing both Goblin tokens, dealing 2 damage to any target.
At the beginning of your end step, Emeritus of Woe triggers, preparing itself.
Repeat each turn, finding any card of your choice in step 4 instead of Siege-Gang Lieutenant.
